Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Goblet squat
3 sets8-12 repsAny kit7kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest with both hands, elbows tucked down, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the weight at the chest and the torso upright, then drive up through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, never caving in, and the heels flat. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and squat only as deep as you can control comfortably.

Romanian deadlift
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit8kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, holding a weight in front of your thighs, or hands empty, with a soft bend in the knees. Set the shoulders back and brace the core.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front of your legs, keeping it close, until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never let it round. The movement is a hip hinge, not a squat, and the weight stays close to your legs. Only go as low as you can keep the back flat.

Chest press – band, standing
3 sets8-12 repsBand/AnchorBlack band
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Anchor a band behind you, a handle in each hand at chest height, staggered stance, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Press the hands forward until the arms are nearly straight, then return under control to the chest.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the ribs down, not arching to press. Keep the elbows a little below shoulder height, and control the band on the return.

Balance – single leg with arm reach
3 sets30s each sideBodyweightBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, other foot lifted, arms ready to reach.

Movement: Reach the arms (and torso if set) out to the sides or forward, challenging balance, then return to centre.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft as you reach, moving slowly. Fix the eyes on a point, keep the core engaged, and return under control.

Glute bridge – march
2 sets8 each sideMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Hold a bridge at the top with the hips fully extended and level, feet hip-width, core braced.

Movement: Without letting the hips drop, lift one foot a few centimetres off the floor, set it down, then the other, in a slow march.

Focus: Keep the hips absolutely still and level, no rocking or dipping as the foot lifts. The glutes and core hold the position throughout.

Dead bug – arms and legs
3 sets8-10 each sideMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent over the hips, arms towards the ceiling, lower back pressed gently into the floor.

Movement: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly towards the floor, keeping the back flat, then return and swap sides.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor as the limbs extend, never letting it arch. Move slowly and controlled, and shorten the reach if the back lifts.

w/c 2 Nov 2026 · Hinge & Pull & Carry
Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap a move for cues.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Pull-through – band
2 sets8-10 repsBandBlack
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand facing away from a low band, the band between the legs held in both hands, hinged forward with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Drive the hips forward to stand tall, pulling the band through, squeezing the glutes, then hinge back under control.

Focus: Drive the movement from the hips and glutes, not the arms or lower back, keeping the back flat. Stand tall with the ribs down at the top, and control the hinge back.

Bent-over row – underhand
3 sets8-12 repsAny kit2 x 7kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Feet hip-width, a weight in each hand, palms facing forward. Push the hips back and hinge until the chest is well forward, back flat, arms hanging below the shoulders.

Movement: Pull the weights towards the lower ribs, elbows tight to your sides, then lower under control without standing up.

Focus: The underhand grip keeps the elbows close, so the pull goes lower down the back and brings the biceps in. Hold the hinge still and flat, no bobbing, neck long.

Waiter carry – single arm
3 sets30mAny kit7kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall holding a weight overhead in one hand, arm straight, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the weight stable overhead.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back to hold the weight up, staying tall. Keep the shoulder stable and the arm straight, and resist tipping to either side.

Single leg deadlift to overhead press
2 sets8-10 each sideAny kit3kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand on one leg holding a weight, soft standing knee, core braced, the other leg ready to trail behind.

Movement: Hinge at the hip and lower the weight as the free leg lifts behind, return to standing, then press the weight overhead. Lower and repeat.

Focus: Keep the back flat and hips level through the hinge, and don't rush the balance. Press with a braced core so the lower back doesn't arch to help the weight up.

Sit-up pass
3 sets8-12 repsAny kit/Mat5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, holding a med ball, ready to sit up, ribs down.

Movement: Sit up and pass or place the ball forward, then lower under control and repeat.

Focus: Curl up from the abdominals and keep the neck neutral, not throwing the head. Control the sit-up and the lower, and keep the movement smooth.

Hip abduction – clamshell
3 sets8-12 each sideBand/MatRed band
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your side, hips and knees bent, feet together, hips stacked, a band around the thighs if used.

Movement: Keeping the feet together, open the top knee up like a clam, then lower under control.

Focus: Open only as far as the hips stay stacked, not rolling the top hip back. Keep the movement slow, and feel the outer hip and glute work.

Box squat – weighted

Start: Stand in front of a box at about knee height holding a light weight at the chest, feet hip to shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then stand tall through the heels, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes and the chest up. Sit back under control rather than dropping onto the box, and drive up through the heels.

2 x 8-10 · 7kg
Suitcase deadlift

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a single weight on the floor beside one foot.

Movement: Hinge and bend the knees to take the weight, then drive through the floor and stand tall with it at your side. Lower under control. Swap sides halfway.

Focus: The load is on one side, so the trunk has to stop you leaning towards it. Shoulders and hips level all the way, back flat, weight close to the leg.

2 x 8-10 each side · 7kg
Overhead press – standing

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, ribs down, glutes and core braced.

Movement: Press the dumbbells overhead until the arms are straight, then lower back to the shoulders under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and squeeze the glutes so the lower back doesn't arch as you press. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears, and press within a comfortable range.

3 x 8-12 · 2 x 5kg
ISO single leg deadlift

Start: Stand on one leg, a soft bend in the knee, holding a weight in front of the thigh, the other leg ready to trail behind.

Movement: Hinge at the hip and lower the weight down the standing leg while the free leg lifts behind, reach a flat-backed stretch, then hold that bottom position still.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hips level, don't let the raised hip open out. Hold steady through the hips and standing glute, and keep the weight close to the leg.

2 x 20s each side · Moderate
Calf raises – loaded single leg

Start: Stand on one foot, the ball of the foot on a step edge, a weight in the hand, holding a support with the other.

Movement: Rise up onto the toes as high as you comfortably can, then lower the heel slowly under control.

Focus: Rise and lower slowly and evenly, not bouncing, through the full comfortable range. Keep the ankle tracking straight, not rolling out, and control the lower.

3 x 8-12 each side · Light
Side plank – with leg raise

Start: Set up in a side plank, body straight, shoulder over the elbow, feet stacked.

Movement: Lift the top leg a short way and hold both the plank and the raised leg still for the set time.

Focus: Keep the hips lifted and level as the leg raises, resisting any sag or roll. Keep the shoulder stacked and the body in one line, and lower out if the hips drop.

3 x 40s each side · Bodyweight

Squat – at sides

Start: Hold a weight in each hand by your sides, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, core braced.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the chest up, then drive through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the heels down throughout. Keep the chest up and the core braced, and go only as deep as your knees and hips stay comfortable.

3 x 8-12 · 2 x 10kg
Swings – KB

Start: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor in front, feet hip-width, hinged with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Hike the kettlebell back between the legs, then drive the hips forward to swing it up to about chest height, letting it swing back down into the next hinge.

Focus: Power the swing from a sharp hip drive, not the arms or lower back, keeping the back flat throughout. Snap the glutes at the top with the ribs down, and let the arms just guide the bell.

3 x 8-12 · 12kg
Push-up – band

Start: Loop a band across the upper back and under the hands, set up in a push-up position, body in a straight line, core braced.

Movement: Lower the chest towards the floor, then press back up against the band's resistance, keeping the line.

Focus: Keep the body straight, not sagging at the hips. Keep the elbows tucked and the shoulders down, and control the press against the added band tension.

Renegade row

Start: Set up in a push-up position gripping two dumbbells, feet wide for stability, body in a straight line, core braced hard.

Movement: Row one dumbbell to the hip while balancing on the other, lower it, then row the other side.

Focus: Keep the hips level and square, resisting the twist as you row, which is the whole point. Keep the body in a straight line, brace hard, and control each row.

3 x 8-12 each side · 2 x 5kg
Gorilla row

Start: Feet wide, a weight on the floor under each shoulder. Hinge over with a flat back and take hold of both, knees soft.

Movement: Row one weight up to the ribs while the other hand pushes down into its weight to hold you steady. Lower it, then row the other side. Keep alternating.

Focus: Both hands stay loaded the whole time, which is what makes it steadier than a single arm row. Hips and shoulders square, no twisting to get the weight up, back flat.

3 x 8-12 each side · 2 x 7kg
Reverse fly – single arm

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back, a light dumbbell in one hand hanging below the chest, elbow softly bent, other hand supporting.

Movement: Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height, squeezing the shoulder blade, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep a soft elbow bend and lead with the back of the hand, squeezing the shoulder blade. Keep the back flat and don't swing or shrug, using a light weight.

3 x 10 · 3kg
Single leg deadlift – bodyweight

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, the other leg ready to travel back, standing knee soft, arms ready.

Movement: Hinge forward from the hip, letting the free leg travel back and the arms lower, then return to standing.

Focus: Hinge from the hip with a flat back, keeping the hips level and not opening out. Keep the standing knee soft, move slowly, and control the return.

3 x 10 · Bodyweight

Deadlift

Side bends

Movement: Bend slowly to the loaded side, lowering the weight down the leg, then use the opposite waist to pull yourself back upright.

Focus: Bend only to the side, no leaning forward or back, and control the movement with the waist rather than dropping. Keep the hips still and don't overload into end range.

Movement: Step wide to one side, sitting the hips back into the bent leg while the other stays fairly straight, then push back to centre.

Focus: Keep the bent knee over the foot, not caving in, and the chest up with the bell close. Sit into the hip rather than the knee, and push back through the heel.

3 x 8-12 each side · 5kg
Bird-dog – weighted arm

Movement: Reach the weighted arm and the opposite leg out level with the body, hold briefly, then return and repeat, swapping as set.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square and the back flat, resisting the twist the added weight encourages. Move slowly, and keep the reach to where the neutral spine holds.

Glute bridge – single leg

Start: Lie on your back, one knee bent with the foot flat, the other leg extended straight out and held off the floor.

Movement: Drive through the heel of the bent leg to push your hips up until the body is level. Hold two seconds, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Keep the hips level, don't let the free side drop or twist. Push with the glute, not the lower back, and keep the ribs down.

V-sit ups

Movement: Lift the torso and legs together to meet in a V, reaching towards the feet, then lower under control.

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back, a light dumbbell in one hand hanging below the chest, elbow softly bent, other hand supporting.

Movement: Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height, squeezing the shoulder blade, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep a soft elbow bend and lead with the back of the hand, squeezing the shoulder blade. Keep the back flat and don't swing or shrug, using a light weight.

· 5kg
Band pull-apart

Start: Stand tall holding a band in front at shoulder height with straight arms, elbows softly bent, ribs down.

Movement: Pull the band apart out to the sides, squeezing the shoulder blades, then return under control.

Focus: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging. Keep a soft elbow bend and the ribs down, and control the return.

· Red
Tricep overhead – band

Start: Stand on one end of a band, or anchor it low behind you, and hold the other end in both hands behind the head, elbows pointing up, ribs down.

Movement: Straighten the arms to press the hands overhead against the band, then lower slowly behind the head, keeping the elbows still and pointing up.

Focus: Move only at the elbows, keeping the upper arms still and close to the head. Keep the ribs down and don't arch the lower back as the band pulls the hands back.

· Red band
w/c 13 Jul 2026 · Knee-Friendly Strength▼
Goblet squat

Start: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest with both hands, elbows tucked down, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the weight at the chest and the torso upright, then drive up through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes, never caving in, and the heels flat. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and squat only as deep as you can control comfortably.

3 x 10 · 7kg
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, a dumbbell in each hand resting in front of your thighs, knees softly bent, core braced.

Movement: Push the hips back and lower the dumbbells down the front of your legs, keeping them close, until you feel the hamstrings stretch. Drive the hips forward to return.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the dumbbells close throughout. Hinge at the hips, don't squat or round the back. Go only as low as your flat back allows.

3 x 10 · 2 x 7kg
DB floor press – single arm

Start: Lie on your back on the mat, knees bent, feet flat, one dumbbell in one hand at chest height, the upper arm resting lightly on the floor with the elbow at about 45 degrees.

Movement: Press the dumbbell up until the arm is nearly straight, then lower under control until the upper arm rests back on the floor.

Focus: Let the elbow touch the floor gently each rep rather than crashing down, and keep the shoulder blade set. Because it is one side at a time, brace the trunk so it does not twist toward the working arm.

3 x 8 each side · 7kg
Single arm row – DB

Start: Hand and knee on a bench, the other foot planted, a dumbbell in the free hand hanging down, back flat and level.

Movement: Pull the dumbbell towards the hip, driving the elbow back and up, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbow and squeeze the shoulder blade, keeping the back flat and level, not twisting to lift. Keep the shoulder down, and control the lower.

3 x 10 each side · 8kg
Lateral band walks

Start: Stand with a band around the legs (ankles or above the knees), feet hip-width, knees softly bent, torso tall.

Movement: Step sideways one foot at a time, keeping tension on the band, for the set steps, then return the other way.

Focus: Keep tension on the band throughout and the feet pointing forward, not letting the knees cave in. Stay low and controlled, and feel the outer hips work.

2 x 12 each side · Light
Bird-dog

Start: On all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat and neutral, core braced.

Movement: Reach the opposite arm and leg out straight until level with the body, hold briefly, then return under control and swap.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square to the floor and the back flat, resisting any twist or sag as the limbs extend. Move slowly, and reach only as far as you keep the neutral spine.

3 x 10 each side · Bodyweight
w/c 6 Jul 2026 · Band Strength — Knee-Friendly▼
Band deadlift

Start: Stand on the middle of a band, feet hip to shoulder-width, and take a handle or the band in each hand. Hinge down with a flat back, chest up.

Movement: Drive through the floor and stand tall against the band's pull, squeezing the glutes at the top, then hinge the hips back to lower with control.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, power from the hips and legs. Control the return, don't let the band snap you back down.

2 x 10 · Black band
Band squat

Start: Stand on a band, feet shoulder-width, holding the band at the shoulders or looped over them, chest up, core braced.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat against the band's tension, then drive up to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the heels down. Let the band add resistance without pulling you forward, and squat only as deep as your knees stay comfortable.

3 x 12 · Black band
Band push-up

Start: Loop a band across the upper back and under the hands, set up in a push-up position, body in a straight line, core braced.

Movement: Lower the chest towards the floor, then press back up against the band's resistance, keeping the line.

Focus: Keep the body straight, not sagging at the hips. Keep the elbows tucked and the shoulders down, and control the press against the added band tension.

2 x 10 · Yellow
Band row – seated on floor

Start: Sit on the floor, legs straight out, band looped around the feet, sitting tall from the hips, chest up.

Movement: Pull the band towards your lower abdomen, driving the elbows back, then return under control.

Focus: Drive the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades, not just bending the arms. Keep sitting tall with no rocking, and keep the shoulders down away from the ears.

3 x 12 · Black band
Foot anchored wood chops low to high

Start: Anchor a resistance band under one foot and hold the other end in both hands down by the opposite hip, feet hip-width, knees soft, core braced.

Movement: Sweep the band up and across from the low hip to above the opposite shoulder, rotating through the trunk, then return under control.

Focus: Drive the rotation through the hips and trunk together, ribs down, and control the band back down. Don't yank with the arms or twist the lower back.

2 x 10 each · Black band
Band crab walks

Start: Stand with a band around the legs, feet hip-width, knees softly bent, in a slight squat, torso tall.

Movement: Step diagonally forward and out one foot at a time, keeping tension on the band, then continue for the set steps.

Focus: Keep tension on the band and the knees pushing out, not caving in. Stay low and controlled, and feel the outer hips and glutes work.

3 x 10 each · Black
Dead bug – arms and legs

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent over the hips, arms towards the ceiling, lower back pressed gently into the floor.

Movement: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly towards the floor, keeping the back flat, then return and swap sides.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor as the limbs extend, never letting it arch. Move slowly and controlled, and shorten the reach if the back lifts.

2 x 10 each · Bodyweight
